name: cv32e40p_crc32_stage5_local_diagnostic_semantics
scope_statement: The oracle characterizes workload activation, injection effectiveness, injected-site divergence, direct-receiver divergence, and final CRC32/progress outcome. It does not claim full architectural propagation unless an architectural checkpoint is explicitly monitored in a later stage.

classes.SIMULATION_ERROR_OR_UNKNOWN: The runner did not produce a valid fault run verdict or reported ERROR/UNKNOWN/compile-only status.
classes.TRACE_INVALID: One or both compact traces are missing, empty, malformed, or contain no usable cycle samples.
classes.TRACE_SCOPE_MISMATCH: Both traces are valid but no normalized bound scope is shared.
classes.INJECTION_ERROR: At least one matched scope does not show the observed injected site constrained to the requested stuck-at value.
classes.FACT_CONTRADICTION: The final outcome reports timeout or output corruption although the golden trace does not show the activating source value; the experiment requires investigation rather than a masking label.
classes.NOT_ACTIVATED: The golden source never took the complement of the stuck-at value under this workload.
classes.DETECTED_HANG: The injection was valid and activated, and the workload reached the frozen maximum-cycle timeout verdict.
classes.DETECTED_OUTPUT_CORRUPTION: The injection was valid and activated, and the final CRC32/signature outcome mismatched.
classes.LOCAL_PROPAGATION_MASKED_AT_OUTPUT: The final output matched, but at least one directly observed receiver output diverged from golden. This is a local propagation statement, not a full architectural-masking claim.
classes.SITE_DIVERGENCE_LOCALLY_MASKED: The injected site diverged from golden, no directly observed receiver output diverged, and the final output matched.
classes.FUNCTIONALLY_EQUIVALENT_UNDER_WORKLOAD: The fault was activated and injected effectively, but no sampled site/receiver divergence or final-output difference was observed under this workload.
